english_source: The fuel pump was leaking during the pre-flight inspection.
draft_code_switched: Wakati wa pre-flight inspection, fuel pump ilikuwa inavuja.

english_source: The outgoing technician did not mention the deferred item in the logbook. This caused confusion for the next shift.
draft_code_switched: Fundi wa zamu iliyopita hakutaja ile deferred item kwenye logbook. This caused a lot of confusion for the next shift.

english_source: We skipped the torque check because we were running late, you know?
draft_code_switched: Tulikosa kufanya torque check kwa sababu tulikuwa tumechelewa, unajua?

english_source: There was a small object on the runway near the aircraft.
draft_code_switched: Kulikuwa na kitu kidogo kwenye runway karibu na aircraft.

english_source: I was very tired by the end of the shift. I might have missed something on the checklist.
draft_code_switched: Nilikuwa nimechoka sana mwishoni mwa zamu. Huenda nilikosa kitu kwenye checklist.

english_source: Please double check the hydraulic system before you sign off, okay?
draft_code_switched: Tafadhali angalia tena hydraulic system kabla ya ku-sign off, sawa?

english_source: The inspector found a crack near the landing gear.
draft_code_switched: Inspector alipata crack karibu na landing gear.

english_source: The part was not available in stores. We had to wait until morning.
draft_code_switched: Ile part haikuwepo kwenye stores. Tulilazimika kusubiri mpaka asubuhi.
reviewer_corrected_version: Ile part haikuwepo kwenye ghala. Tulilazimika kusubiri mpaka asubuhi.

english_source: The MEL item is still open, right?
draft_code_switched: Ile MEL item bado iko open, sio?

english_source: He forgot to update the work card after the repair.
draft_code_switched: Alisahau ku-update ile work card baada ya repair.

english_source: The tug driver did not see the wingtip clearance marker.
draft_code_switched: Dereva wa tug hakuona ile wingtip clearance marker.

english_source: I told him twice about the open panel, but he said he never heard me.
draft_code_switched: Nilimwambia mara mbili kuhusu ile open panel, lakini akasema hakuwahi kunisikia.
confidence_note: MODERATE - verify natural phrasing of 'akasema hakuwahi kunisikia'

english_source: The APU would not start on the second attempt.
draft_code_switched: APU haikuweza ku-start kwenye jaribio la pili.

english_source: Sign the handover sheet before you leave, please.
draft_code_switched: Tia sahihi kwenye handover sheet kabla hujaondoka, tafadhali.

english_source: It was a long night. Honestly, I just wanted to finish and go home.
draft_code_switched: Ilikuwa usiku mrefu. Kwa uaminifu, nilitaka tu ku-maliza na kuenda nyumbani.
confidence_note: MODERATE - 'kwa uaminifu' for 'honestly' feels slightly formal, verify natural equivalent
reviewer_corrected_version: Ilikuwa usiku mrefu. Kwa kweli,nilitaka tu kumaliza na kuenda nyumbani.

english_source: Someone left a tool near the engine cowling. That's a serious safety issue.
draft_code_switched: Mtu aliacha tool karibu na engine cowling. Hiyo ni safety issue kubwa.

english_source: Did you close out the work order, or is it still pending?
draft_code_switched: Ulifunga ile work order, ama bado iko pending?

english_source: The tire pressure was below limits, so we replaced it before dispatch.
draft_code_switched: Tire pressure ilikuwa chini ya limit, kwa hivyo tulibadilisha kabla ya dispatch.

english_source: Next time, write it down. Don't just tell the next shift verbally, eh?
draft_code_switched: Wakati mwingine, iandike. Usimwambie tu zamu inayofuata kwa mdomo, eh?
confidence_note: MODERATE - verify 'eh' tag placement sounds natural here vs 'sio' or 'unajua'

english_source: We need to update the maintenance log before the aircraft goes back into service.
draft_code_switched: Tunahitaji ku-update maintenance log kabla ndege haijarudi kwenye service.
